content_html:
PUBG MOBILE will begin pushing out the Version 4.3 Evolving Universe update without interrupting service on March 12. The update should be available to all players by March 12 at 11:00 (UTC+0). Any changes to the update schedule will be announced at the earliest notice.Update the game to get the 8th Anniversary Theme Song and New Version Themed Lobby Background, which will be automatically sent to your game account.


Version Highlights

● New Evolving Universe Themed Mode: The new character skill specialization system lets you create highlights based on your specialty, whether you're a sharpshooter, master medic, scouting sentinel, stealth hunter, or vehicle expert.

● Classic Mode: New M1 Garand sniper rifle and upgraded Tracked Amphicarrier vehicle have been added.

● New UI: Smoother and streamlined for a new sensory experience.

● New Card Collection System: Get a free 3-level upgradable firearm on your first try! Multiple exclusvie card series are now available. Collect them all to unlock the gallery!

● WOW: WOW 3rd Anniversary, upgraded incentive system, plus US $10 million prize pool available all year!

● Key Gameplay/Event Periods: Time Zone is UTC+0

✧ New Evolving Universe Themed Mode: 2026/3/11 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 20:59

✧ V2.1's Ancient Secret: Arise Themed Mode: Returns in early April! Stay tuned!

✧ S29 Classic & Casual Season: 2026/3/15 at 2:00–2026/5/15 at 23:59

✧ S29 Ultimate Royale: 2026/3/23 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 23:59

✧ Metro Royale Season: 2026/3/13 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 20:59

✧ Ranked Arena: 2026/3/26 at 2:00–2026/4/23 at 23:59

✧ Crazy Chicken Day Event: Rules are the same as in last version. Available in different regions on Friday/Saturday/Sunday.

● IP Collaborations: Major collaborations featuring the popular anime Jujutsu Kaisen, renowned band OneRepublic, and top creator MrBeast are coming, kicking off the 8th Anniversary with a grand collaboration party! More excitement is coming to the battlegrounds!


Themed Mode: Evolving Universe

● Available: 2026/3/11 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 20:59 (UTC+0)

● Maps: Erangel, Livik, and Miramar. The specific gameplay content varies by map, as follows:

✧ Erangel: All themed mode content will be available.

✧ Livik: All content except music rails will be available.

✧ Miramar: All content except the revamped urban areas, music rails, and parachute challenge will be available.


In-Match Growth Mechanic


Character Class Skill

Every player has a different playstyle. We hope everyone will be able to create highlights based on their specialty, whether they're a sharpshooter, master medic, scouting sentinel, stealth hunter, or vehicle expert.

Choose one of 5 passive skills: Healing, Combat, Recon, Detection, and Vehicle. Each specialization is divided into C/B/A/S ranks, starting at C-rank. Complete match missions to upgrade and enhance skills.

●Healing Skill:

✧ C-Rank: Use consumables faster.

✧ B-Rank: Use consumables much faster.

✧ A-Rank: Rescue teammates faster.

✧ S-Rank: Rescue teammates faster, and rescued teammates recover additional Health.

●Combat Skill:

✧C-Rank: Faster reload speed after downing or defeating an enemy.

✧B-Rank: Significantly faster reload speed after downing or defeating an enemy.

✧ A-Rank: Recover Health after downing or defeating an enemy.

✧ S-Rank: Recover more Health after downing or defeating an enemy.

●Recon Skill:

✧ C-Rank: Hit an enemy to mark them for a period of time (visible to teammates).

✧ B-Rank: Hit an enemy to mark them for a longer period of time (visible to teammates).

✧ A-Rank: Enemies that hit you are automatically marked.

✧ S-Rank: Enemies that hit you are automatically marked for a longer period of time.

●Detection Skill:

✧ C-Rank: Go prone for a while to detect nearby supplies.

✧ B-Rank: Go prone for a shorter duration to detect nearby supplies.

✧ A-Rank: Scan in a certain range to detect nearby enemies and vehicles, even while crawling.

✧ S-Rank: Scan in a larger range to detect nearby enemies and vehicles, even while crawling.

●Vehicle Skill:

✧ C-Rank: Vehicles consume less fuel and take less damage.

✧ B-Rank: Vehicles consume less fuel, take less damage, and tires are harder to blow out.

✧ A-Rank: Take less fall damage when exiting a moving vehicle.

✧ S-Rank: Take much less fall damage when exiting a moving vehicle.

●Skill Selection: Select or change specializations outside of matches or on Spawn Island.


Energy Rank Mechanic

Everyone can be the #1! Eliminations aren't the only thing that matters in matches. The new mechanic lets you grow through gameplay such as healing, scouting, and driving, so that every player's value is reflected in the match.

● Energy Ranks are divided into C/B/A/S. All players start at C-rank, and can increase their rank by gaining Energy Points in matches.

● Certain gameplay in matches will earn Energy Points. Points can be used to upgrade class skills or unlock higher-rank Temporal Vaults.

✧ Earn points by dealing damage, rescuing teammates, exploring urban areas, driving vehicles, and more. Explore freely in matches for more ways to earn points.


Temporal Vault Gameplay

We cherish every game version we've shared with our players. This time, we've hidden elements from past versions as special surprises within familiar buildings and interactive objects. We hope these unexpected Temporal Vaults bring back fond memories of the past.

As your Energy Rank increases, you can unlock different tiers of Temporal Vaults in matches. These vaults are hidden on the battleground as classic structures. When a player reaches the required level and interacts with them, the structures will dissolve, revealing the Temporal Vault.

●B-Rank Vault: Appears as a small building with dynamic effects. Interact with it to dissolve and reveal an exclusive 8th Anniversary crate containing special rewards.

●A-Rank Vault: Travel through time to a random classic version theme from 2021 to 2024. The vault will display iconic objects from that version. Interacting with them triggers an exclusive performance and switches the interior scene to the corresponding style, before revealing themed crates.

●S-Rank Vault: Classic Erangel theme. Interact with the sandbox to predict the next Playzone location and change the weather in the area to rain. All exhibits in the vault can be interacted with to trigger special effects and obtain extra rewards. There is also an armory providing high-quality supplies.

●Anniversary Lucky Spin:

✧ Obtain In-Match: Anniversary Lucky Spins will randomly appear in A-rank and S-rank vaults. Interact for a chance to get vouchers for different quality items.

✧ Extract From Match: Meet any of the following conditions to extract vouchers from the match.

➢ Condition 1: Meet the specified individual rank requirement when the match ends.

➢ Condition 2: Use the drone in-match to retrieve items early.

✧ Rewards: Open the supply crate in your inventory for a chance to get Legendary finishes, melee weapons, UC vouchers, and other rewards.

➢ From 3/13–4/12, crates obtained have a chance to drop the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration Aoi Todo Set and Aoi Todo Cover.

➢From 4/13–5/10, crates obtained have a chance to drop the Fire Extinguisher - Machete melee weapon finish.


Themed Areas

Familiar cities will change in appearance and structure. We hope these changes directly translate into new tactical gameplay, allowing everyone to experience new tricks in old places.

●Urban Area Transformation: Midway into the match, some areas will experience temporal distortions, where buildings within these areas will dynamically transform into a brand new modern style.

✧ Location:

➢ Erangel: Pochinki, Mylta, Mansion, Hospital

➢ Livik: Midtstein, Blomster

●Openable Garage Door: Added an interactive garage door that players can control. When opened, the door can serve as a climbing platform, helping players quickly reach the second floor or windows, creating new attack and defense routes.

✧ Map: Erangel


Gameplay Mechanics

The revamped urban areas will lead to more intense engagements. Therefore, a new rail has been added, offering tactical options for moving around quickly, reconnaissance, and surprise attacks. Racing and parachuting gameplay have also been added, injecting unique fun into intense battles.


●Racing Challenge

✧ Map-Wide Races: Multiple race tracks have been added to the map. Drive your vehicle against the clock, hit checkpoints, and reach the finish line to win great rewards. Race tracks features special devices like jump pads and boost pads, offering an exciting and varied driving experience.

✧ Dual Modes: Challenges are divided into two modes: Single Lap Sprint and Multi-Lap Race. Complete a track for the first time to receive great rewards, and break your personal record to win extra supplies.

✧ Maps: Erangel, Livik, and Miramar

●Parachute Challenge

✧ New parachute challenge points have been added to the map. Use special ascent devices to launch into the air, glide, and precisely land on the bullseye platform to receive supply rewards.

✧ This mechanic is not just a challenge, but also a powerful tactical tool: you can use it for high-altitude reconnaissance or to quickly move long distances. There's no need to worry about failing the challenge, as there are no penalties.

✧ Maps: Erangel and Livik

●Dynamic Slide Rail

✧ High-altitude music slide rails have been added to the battleground. Traverse these rails at high speed to get around quickly. There will be lively music and dance emotes when sliding, for a unique experience in the thick of combat.

✧ Map: Erangel

Themed Item

Energy Shield

Forget about complicated tactics. Protect your team in the most direct way!

●Skill Description:

✧ Pick it up to deploy a large spherical shield.

✧ Dual-Directional Defense: The shield blocks shots from going in or out in all directions, providing a temporary safe zone for the squad.

✧ Energy Recovery: All allied units within the shield will continuously recover Energy, allowing longer sustained combat for the team.


Vehicle Floating Thruster

Equip your ride with thrusters and experience ultimate speed and passion!


●Skill Description: Equip your vehicle with thrusters to gain powerful burst acceleration. Chasing enemies, capturing points, and escaping has never been easier.

✧ How to Obtain:

➢ Fixed Locations: Head to a gas station or race track on the map to find a modification bench to install the Floating Thruster on your vehicle.

➢ Item Pickup: Find and pick up the Portable Thruster item on the map to install it on your current vehicle at any time.

●Supported Vehicles: All non-animal vehicles are supported (Horses, Camels, and other animal vehicles are not supported).


Additionally, the V2.1's highly anticipated themed mode, Ancient Secret: Arise, will make a surprise return in early April. We invite everyone to embark on a new adventure within the mysterious ancient secret!


Classic Mode Updates

Firearm Updates

A classic firearm with a bayonet melee attack has been added. We hope this design expands the combat experience for semi-auto sniper rifles.

●New Firearm: M1 Garand sniper rifle

✧ A classic semi-automatic firearm with excellent handling and accuracy.

✧ When the magazine is emptied, it will make a distinctive "ping" sound.

Comes with a bayonet for melee thrusts, balancing long-range sniping with close-quarters counterattacks.

●Firearm Availability Adjustment:

✧ S12K: Added to Livik as a ground supply.

✧ Mini14: Added to Sanhok and Livik as a ground supply.

✧ Honey Badger: Added to Miramar, Karakin, Vikendi, Rondo, and Nusa as a ground supply.


VEHICLE UPDATES

The current amphibious armored vehicle, the BRDM-2, is slightly less appealing when competing with air drop weapons. To address this, we have updated the air drop vehicle, hoping it will become a more distinctive and competitive strategic choice.

●New Vehicle: Tracked Amphicarrier

✧ Summoned by flare gun, it replaces the original BRDM-2 amphibious armored vehicle.

✧ Features a tracked design with rapid acceleration and strong obstacle-crossing capabilities. It can also be driven on land and in water, and supports turning in place.

✧ The passenger in the front seat can operate a heavy machine gun for suppressive fire.

● Improved Vehicle Handling: The handling for the four-seater convertible sports car, Mirado, has been improved with greater stability and a lower chance of flipping over.


Erangel Map Updates

● Revamped Spawn Island

✧ Military Style Remodel: Spawn Island has been fully upgraded to resemble a military fortress, enhancing the atmosphere.

✧ New Gear Trial Zone: Here, you can try out the latest gear in advance and familiarize yourself with them.

✧ Expanded Facilities: Added a small shooting range and increased the spawn rate of sports cars.

● Improved Weather System

✧At the start of the match, one of the following effects will randomly appear:

➢Sunny: Clear sky with some clouds.

➢Dusk: Lighting and colors are more vibrant.

➢Overcast: Slightly increased brightness, with improved visibility in dim environments.

Basic Combat Improvements

● Sound Prompts: The visual direction of sound effects when hit will dynamically adjust based on the direction the character is facing, enhancing the realism of auditory feedback on the battleground.

● Expanded Player Carrying Mechanics: When a downed player is carried into a vehicle, other players can carry them out from outside the vehicle.

● In-Match Map Improvements:

✧Improved the layout of common function buttons on the expanded mini-map to be more intuitive.

✧Tap an icon in the legend list to hide or show them on the mini-map. Hold a legend icon to highlight it on the mini-map.

✧Added an adaptive scaling feature: This feature is enabled by default at the start of each match when the mini-map is expanded, automatically adjusting the center point and zoom level. If the player manually adjusts the zoom, the feature will automatically turn off and can be re-enabled via the dedicated button on the right after expanding.

● Improved Firearm Pickup Descriptions: Added applicable scope descriptions to ground firearms when being picked up to help players quickly understand where they are best used.

● Carry Teammates Out of Vehicles: Downed teammates carried into vehicles can now also be carried out for relocation and rescue.


Season Update

Advancement Match

Since the launch of Promotion Matches, we've received a lot of feedback regarding it being too hard and not being able to team up with friends. The new version features improvements that address these issues. We hope these adjustments will make your path to promotion smoother and allow you to fight alongside your friends more often.


●Rule Improvements

✧ Lower Requirements:

➢ Promoting to Ace: Unlocked upon reaching 4,199 rating points and individually ranking in the top 15 in Erangel or top 8 in Livik in 3 consecutive matches.

➢ Promoting to Ace Master: Unlocked upon reaching 4,699 rating points and individually ranking in the top 12 in Erangel or top 6 in Livik in 3 consecutive matches.

➢ Promoting to Ace Dominator: Unlocked upon reaching 5,200 rating points and individually ranking in the top 10 in Erangel or top 5 in Livik in 4 consecutive matches.

✧ Expanded Team-Up Range:

➢ Promoting to Ace: Teammates must be Diamond V tier or higher.

➢ Promoting to Ace Master: Teammates must be Crown V tier or higher.

➢ Promoting to Ace Dominator: Teammates must be Ace tier or higher.


S29 Classic Season

● Season Duration: 2026/3/15 at 2:00–2026/5/15 at 23:59 (UTC+0)

● Updated Season Rewards:

✧ Platinum: Updated Season Set, Season Bonus Point Card ×2.

✧ Diamond: Updated Season Firearms, Main Page Info Card.

✧ Crown: Updated Season Parachute, Rating Protection Card ×3.

✧ Ace: Updated Season Backpack, Season Mask, MVP Badge.

✧ Ace Master: Updated Season Helmet, Cover, Squad Results Pose.

✧ Ace Dominator: Updated Badge Display Emote, MVP Emote.

✧ Path of Glory Exclusive Rewards: Dynamic Nickname, Intro Animation, Dynamic Avatar. Obtainable upon reaching Ace Dominator 30 Stars.


S29 Casual Season

● Season Duration: 2026/3/15 at 2:00–2026/5/15 at 23:59 (UTC+0)


S29 Ultimate Royale

● Season Duration: 2026/3/23 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 23:59 (UTC+0)


Season Series

●2026 H1 Season Series: New Season Series Trial Missions. After updating, choose 10 out of 15 missions to challenge.


World of Wonder Updates

Editor Updates

We've noticed that Creators spend a lot of time on repetitive and tedious tasks during map building (e.g., batch placement, alignment, color modification).To address this issue, our main goal of this update is to allow Creators to focus on creativity by further simplifying operations to improve editing efficiency.


●AI Assistant Update:

✧ Voice Interaction: Added voice input, allowing direct communication with the AI assistant by speaking (supports Chinese, English, Russian, Turkish, and Arabic).

✧ Smart Editing Feature

➢ Natural Language Operation: Add, modify, or delete scene objects through text or voice descriptions, with support for batch processing.

➢ Precise Range Control: Added the Smart Editing Box, which allows you to select a specific area for the AI to perform precise edits within.

✧ Experience Improvements:

➢ Visual Progress: There's a real-time progress bar when generating resources with AI, making the process more transparent.

➢ Emote Generation Improvements: Significantly improved the tilt and amplitude issues of AI-generated emotes, resulting in a more natural effect.

➢ Conversation Management: Added an option to clear chat history.


●Resource Center

✧ Expanded Resource Type Support: You can now upload and manage custom images, audio, UI objects, and more. (Audio-related features will be added in a later patch)

✧ Efficient Management & Search:

➢ Storage Management: You can uninstall custom resources from the client to free up storage space on your device.

➢ Preset Filter: Added a "Re-Editable" filter to quickly find modifiable preset resources.

➢ Auto-Categorization: Resources will be automatically categorized upon upload for more efficient searching.

●UI Editor

✧ UI Grouping: Multiple UI controls can be created as a UI grouped object for overall scaling, movement, and control.

✧ Visual Programming Upgrade: Visual programming now supports direct control over the display and hiding of entire UI grouped objects, eliminating the need to do so one by one.

✧ Resource Center Integration: Custom UI grouped objects can now be saved to the Resource Center for reuse across different creations.

✧ Resource Expansion: Added various official UI image assets, such as Badges.

●Performance and Feature Improvements

✧ Performance Improvements: Objects using the same custom material will now be automatically batched for rendering, significantly reducing performance load and improving smoothness.

✧ MVP Customization: Added relevant logic blocks, allowing creators to freely set whether to display the MVP Results Screen and designate the MVP Player.

✧ Adjustable Buff Bar Position: You can now adjust the position of the Buff Status Bar in Custom Button Layout.

✧ In-Match Feedback Channel:

➢ Players can directly submit feedback to the Creator if they encounter issues such as being stuck in the game.

➢ Creators can view key data such as screenshots and device information, which helps them locate and fix issues.

✧ Player Character Characteristics:

➢ Adjust Core Attributes with Blocks: Creators can now freely set four basic player attributes using blocks: Damage Multiplier, Damage Taken Multiplier, Movement Speed Multiplier, and Jump Height Multiplier.

➢ Increased Maximum Movement Speed: The maximum movement speed and jump height multiplier have both increased to 5.


Out-of-Match Features Update

We've noticed that many outstanding creations on the platform haven't received the attention they deserve, and Creators are eager for more valuable feedback. To address this, we've launched the new Curator feature.We hope it helps hidden gems shine and makes it easier for players to discover creations they're interested in. At the same time, excellent reviews can provide valuable reference for Creators, helping them continuously improve.


●Creation Rating and Display Improvements

✧ Full Rating Display: You can now view all rating content for a creation.

✧ Smart Featured Comments: The system automatically filters and displays excellent comments, and Creators can also manage them manually.

✧ Cover Barrage Comments: Selected comments will scroll across the creation's cover as barrage comments, enhancing interactivity.

✧ Rating Cooldown Period: After a Creator disables comments, there will be a 7-day cooldown period, after which it will automatically be re-enabled.

●Creator and Creation Experience Improvements

✧ New Simplified Creator Certification: The questionnaire process has been removed; simply complete the WOW Rookie Tutorial to become a Creator.

✧ Ranking Visibility Improvements:

➢ Details Page: The creation details page will display the ranking by default.

➢ Loading Screen: The loading screen will display brief ranking info, allowing for a quick view of current scores.

✧ Special Collection Feature Improvements:

➢ Information Display: The Special Collection theme will directly display the countdown and event rewards.

➢ Creator Honor Medal: Creators whose creations are selected for a Special Collection will receive an exclusive Medal.

✧ Improved Creation Information Display: Improved the layout of creation covers and the details page, and unified the display of core data such as ratings and playtime.

●Creator Home Page and Editor Upgrades

✧ Upgraded Creation Home Page:

➢ Renamed and Rebuilt: The My page has been renamed to Creation Home Page and its UI has been redone with visual improvements.

➢ Album Management: Added cover and display image management functions.

➢ Data Center Upgrade: Added key data statistics such as visual programming event tracking and second day retention.

✧ Editor Experience Improvements:

➢ Resource Download Process Optimization: Improved how smoothly resources are downloaded when updating creations and collaborating on edits.

➢ Auto-Translate Feature: More functions within the editor now support auto-translation.

●System Improvements

✧ Resource Pack Split: WOW-related resources are split into Essential Play Pack, Popular Map Expansion Pack, and Gameplay Expansion Pack, allowing players to download and manage them as needed.


Resource Integration

● New Main Weapons: ASM, DSR, M1014, Dual MP7, Tactical Crossbow.

● New Melee Weapons: Pickaxe, Dagger.

● New Weapon Attachments: Gun Shield (LMG), Ergonomic Foregrip, Muzzle Brake (AR/SMG/SR), Tactical Gunpowder Tool, Barrel Extender (SR).

● New Functional Items: Self AED, Air Strike Beacon, UAV Drone Bomber.

● New Vehicle: Hovercraft.


Win-Win Earnings Model

●New Creation Shop

✧Core Features

➢ For Creators: You can now list custom paid items in your creations/maps.

➢ For Players: Use WOW Tokens to purchase special items within your favorite creations for a richer, customized gaming experience.

✧Creator Feature Highlights

➢ Diverse Items: Supports the creation of various item types for different purposes.

■ Consumable: Used by count, such as "Respawn Coin."

■ Timed: Effective for a period, such as "VIP Monthly Card."

■ Instant: Immediately gain benefits upon purchase, such as "Currency."

■ Permanent: Unlocks permanent abilities or permissions, such as "Special Skills."

➢ Highly Customizable: Creators can freely set the price, name, description, shop sorting, and specific functions of items.

✧Creator Incentive Program

➢ Earnings Conversion: A portion of the WOW Tokens spent by players on creations will be converted into Crystals, which are the Creator's earnings.

➢ Crystal Usage: Crystals can be withdrawn to your Co-Creation Wallet or redeemed for WOW Tokens for in-game use.

➢ Important Note: Items purchased by players are only valid within the current creation and cannot be used across maps.

●WOW Pass Update

✧Available: 2026/3/11 at 7:00–2026/5/10 at 23:59 (UTC+0)

✧Reward Adjustment:

➢ The free version now also includes the AI cover perk, while the paid version offers additional uses.

➢ Add Home object rewards, and enjoy discounts when purchased together with the Home Pass.

●Mega-Popular Creation Grand Prize

✧Event Period: 2026/3/11 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 23:59 (UTC+0)

●WOW Gift Ranking

✧Season Duration: 2026/3/11 at 2:00–2026/5/10 at 23:59 (UTC+0)


System Updates

The new version introduces a Card Collection System that allows you to easily collect cards and claim upgradable firearm rewards for free. This is the first time an upgradable firearm has been given away for free through an event, and you can also participate in the event to claim free upgrade materials to max out its level!Collect rare and valuable cards from the Anniversary, PMGC, and Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration series to record every highlight moment!


New Card Collection System

●First Phase Grand Prize: Upgradable Splendid Assault - S1897. This is the first time an upgradable firearm has ever been given away for free!

●System Introduction: Each game version will launch multiple themed card sets. Complete specific collection goals to unlock the gallery and great rewards!

●Card Quality: Normal, Rare, Legendary, Holo.

●First Phase Card Series:

✧ Themed Series: Card Design: Incorporates elements of the current themed mode.

✧ Jujutsu Kaisen Collaboration Series: Includes classic elements from Jujutsu Kaisen.

✧ Anniversary Celebration Series: Relive highlights from the 1st to 8th Anniversaries.

✧ PMGC Champion Series: Commemorating the 2025 PMGC Champion Team, FMVP, and various award winners.

●Special Reward

✧ Social Lobby Display: After collecting a specified card set, an exclusive border effect will be unlocked and can be displayed in the Card Showcase in the Social Lobby.

➢ First series available for display: PMGC Series, Jujutsu Kaisen Series, Anniversary Series.

✧ Plane Cabin Performance: Collect a designated card set to perform a grand finale during the pre-flight animation.

➢ First series available for display: PMGC Series, Jujutsu Kaisen Series, Anniversary Series.

✧ Exclusive Emote Display: For series with unlocked showcase displays, an exclusive Card Display Emote will also be included.

●Collection Methods

✧ Designated Mission Cards: Complete designated missions to directly unlock corresponding cards. Each card's detail page shows how it can be obtained.

✧Card Pack Draw: Use theme tokens to redeem packs, or earn packs by completing various missions and events to randomly obtain cards.

✧ Card Gifting: Gift duplicate cards to friends and share the joy of collecting cards.

✧ Card Exchange: Exchange a duplicate card you own for a card of the same quality with another player.

✧ Help Box: Put a duplicate card into the Help Box every day in exchange for a General Card Pack. Additionally, log in every day for a chance to randomly receive a card that another player put in the box. Enjoy mutual help and sharing.

●Past Card Transfer

✧ The original Memory Vault - Adventure Scroll tab has been removed. The Memory Vault system can now be accessed from the flat interface in the bottom-right corner of the Social Lobby.

✧ The Golden Dynasty, Steampunk Frontier, and Transformers series cards from the original Adventure Scroll will be added to the new Card Collection System. Cards you already own can be viewed in Past Cards.

✧ The original Level 1/2/3 cards will all be unified into the new Legendary quality.


Improved Mission System

● Access Point Adjustment: The original Missions access point has been changed to the Card Collection System access point.

● Daily Missions: Missions and rewards have been fully integrated into the new Card Collection System.

● Recall System: The system entrance has been moved from the original Mission Center to the More panel in the Lobby. A complete revamp is planned in future versions, so please stay tuned.

● RP/Home/WOW Pass Missions: Mission content and rewards remain unchanged. Only the access point has been adjusted. The original Lobby shortcut has been removed, but you can still access them from their respective system pages.


Download Experience Improvements

● Improved Inventory Resource Download Logic

✧ To help players better manage network traffic, we have improved the resource download logic. Now, the Auto-Download setting in the download center is now directly linked with the resource loading behavior of your inventory, effectively preventing unexpected data usage.

➢ When players are in a network environment that does not allow automatic download settings, preview resources in the inventory will no longer be automatically downloaded.

➢ Additionally, when you manually download large resources, the system will display a network status notification to prevent accidental data usage.

● More Accurate Resource Download Size Estimate

✧ The estimated size calculation logic for manually downloaded cosmetic resources like outfits and finishes has been improved when previewing them in interfaces such as the shop or Inventory. The system will now fully calculate the total size of all components required for that resource, making the displayed estimated download size more accurate.


Lobby Feature Updates

●Smart Assistant: Your smart companion, Ray, has been upgraded in the new version, bringing more powerful features and interactive experiences.

✧ Interactive Experience Upgrade: You can now hold and drag the 3D assistant Ray in the Lobby for fun interactions with him. Ray now has more varied interactive emotes and improved text communication.

✧ Core Feature Updates:

➢ System Integration: Now integrated with convenient features such as collect all (supports multiple activity systems), featured events, customer service, and security reminders.

➢ News Push: Receive the latest information about new gameplay, new systems, trending community topics, and more.

➢Smart Chat (Beta): Ask questions when chatting with Ray over text, and he will answer anything game-related based on a vast knowledge base.

●Lobby Graphics Enhancement

✧ Added the Lobby Graphics Enhancement feature. It can be enabled in Settings - Graphics.

✧ When enabled, the overall graphics, resolution, special effects, and other visual aspects of the Lobby will be significantly enhanced, providing a more immersive visual experience.

●Lobby Team-Up Improvements

✧ Improved the Team Info Panel with a more concise layout and clearer information display.

✧ Clan, Title, Popularity Battle light boards, banners, and other information have now been integrated into an expandable details panel.

✧ Core information is now more prominent, such as personal honors like Titles, Tiers, Collection Level, and Name Tags, as well as key team information like network status and mic status, allowing you to quickly understand your teammates' situation.

●Social Lobby Revamp

✧ Scene Upgrade: The Social Lobby has been fully revamped and upgraded visually, bringing you a brand new social experience.

✧Firearm Display Cabinet Improvements: The display cabinet has been redesigned. All 6 slots can now be fully displayed on a single screen, so you no longer need to go between different pages.

● The player with the highest global Energy Points will be displayed on billboards throughout the map.

Temporal Vault

As your class rank increases, you can unlock corresponding quality Temporal Vaults in matches. Each Temporal Vault is hidden on the battleground in the form of a classic building. Interact with it after reaching the corresponding rank, and the building will dissolve, revealing the Temporal Vault.

● S-Rank Vault: The vault contains the 2026 map pack. Open it to trigger a sandbox that predicts the next Blue Zone's location. Interact with it again to turn the area into a classic rainy day. The exhibits in the vault can also be interacted with to trigger different effects.

✧ Unified Style: Spawn Island now adopts a militarized visual design, enhancing the immersive battleground atmosphere and matching the theme.

Dear Player,

We have compiled a list of frequently asked questions and answers to help with any problems you might have with using the QR Code Authorized Login feature. Please refer to them below:


Q: How do I scan for authorization?

A: After logging in to the game, the "Authorized Device" can go to Settings - Account - Scan Authorization - QR Code Recognition to authorize another device.



On your second device, tap More - QR Code to generate a QR code. Once authorized, you will be logged out of your account on your original device.



Q: How do I enable feature restrictions for authorized devices using the Authorized Login feature?

A: Tap Settings → Account → Scan Authorization to go to the QR Code Recognition page. On the "Authorized Login Restrictions" interface, you can set usage restrictions for authorized logins, such as for UC, social, or battle functions.



Q: How long does the login authorization last?

A: Devices can be authorized via QR code for up to 30 days at a time. During this period, you can manage authorized devices yourself.


﻿

Q: How do I log in to an authorized account without scanning the QR code again? How do I add a new account?

A: For accounts that have been authorized and are within the authorization period, you can tap "QR Code" in the login channel to log in. If you need to add a new authorized account, tap "Add New Account" below to proceed with QR code authorized login.

content_html:
PUBG MOBILE will begin pushing out the Version 4.2 Primewood Genesis update without interrupting service on January 7, and should be available to all players by January 7 at 11:00 (UTC+0). The actual update schedule may be adjusted for various reasons; any changes will be announced at the earliest notice. Update rewards can be claimed via mail: Themed Music Track "Whisper" ×1, V4.2 Perk Voucher ×20, BP ×1,000, AG ×100. You will also automatically receive the exclusive V4.2 Forest City Theme.


Version Highlights

● New Primewood Genesis Themed Mode Available Now: This version revolves around Erangel and the Sacred Tree, transforming five major urban areas to offer a strong sense of exploration and dynamic combat while retaining a familiar pace. The power of the Sacred Tree descends! Explore and purify a battleground intertwined with new structures and infected plants in this immersive ecological confrontation.

● Skyhigh Spectacle Themed Mode Returns: Additionally, the highly anticipated V3.1 Skyhigh Spectacle themed mode will make a surprise return in early February. Everyone is welcome to embark on a new adventure above the clouds!

● Classic Mode: More firearm balance and battle improvements, with a new cooperative climbing mechanic for smoother vertical combat.

● Season System: New Promotion Match mechanic and Season Series system have both arrived. Enjoy upgraded honor rewards, plus improved competition and challenges.

● World of Wonder: The AI Assistant has been upgraded. Now you can automatically generate grouped objects through text descriptions, and create animations with a single tap by uploading reference videos, to make realizing your creativity even easier.

● Metro Royale: New inheritable weapon, Glacix Arbiter. It features an iconic ice crystal butterfly knife appearance, is swift and deadly, and can defeat enemies in an instant!

● Key Gameplay/Event Periods: Time Zone is UTC+0

✧ New Primewood Genesis Themed Mode: 2026/1/6 at 2:00—2026/3/10 at 20:59

✧ V3.1 Skyhigh Spectacle Themed Mode: Making a surprise return in early February, stay tuned!

✧ S28 Classic & Casual Season: 2026/1/11 at 2:00–2026/3/14 at 23:59

✧ S28 Ultimate Royale: 2026/1/19 at 2:00–2026/3/11 at 23:59

✧ Metro Royale Season: 2026/1/8 at 2:00–2026/3/10 at 20:59

✧ Ranked Arena: 2026/1/27 at 2:00–2026/2/24 at 23:59

✧ ✧ Crazy Chicken Day Event: Rules are the same as in last version. Available in different regions on Friday/Saturday/Sunday.

● IP Collaboration: The collaboration with the highly popular series, Peaky Blinders, will launch on January 9! Stay tuned for more exciting content!


Primewood Genesis Themed Mode

Themed Areas

This time, we've attempted a "fusion of old and new" for 5 urban areas in Erangel—keeping a familiar pace while introducing new changes with tree roots, vines, and nature mechanics. Encounter new buildings, themed gardens, and PvE purification zones in old locations, making looting and battles more dynamic and engaging.


● Urban Area Revamp: Hospital, Pochinki, Sosnovka Military Base, Yasnaya Polyana, and Mylta have been revamped. In addition to new buildings, corrupted plants will appear in the urban areas; defeating these plants will unlock crates wrapped in corrupted vines.

● Corrupting Swamp: In areas of the map with dense sinister energy, grotesque flowers have formed and are threatening the surroundings. Defeat the Corrupting Mega Flower in this area to open a crate and receive great supplies.


Themed Event

●Primewood Purification: All players are invited to participate in the Primewood Purification event. Gather energy to purify the corruption, awaken the vitality of the Primewood, and restore its lush canopy and greenery.

●How to Participate: Any of the following actions contributes to the server's purification progress.

✧ Clear the Corrupting Flowers from the Arborum Sanctuary to cut off the source of corruption.

✧ Defeat the Corrupting Mega Flower in the Corrupting Swamp to receive great supplies and lots of purification energy.

✧ Planting Sacred Fruit also accumulates energy for revitalizing the Primewood.

●Purification Rewards:

✧ When the server-wide purification progress reaches 50%, the Bramblewood Scorpion vehicle will become available in matches. It can burrow and attack, adding strategy and variety to the battlegrounds.

✧ When the server-wide purification progress reaches 100%, the Targeting Vines item will become available in matches. It's a key item that can turn the tide of battle, allowing for both offense and defense.

*Server purification progress can be viewed in "Main page - Themed System" or the Event Center.


Smart Ally

Following the popularity of the penguin ally in V4.1, we now introduce Barkle, the treant ally. He helps block damage, heal, and search for supplies for you in battle, giving a true sense of a silent protector.

● Join the Team: Barkle only appears on Erangel and Livik. Midway into the match, find Barkle on the map and interact with him to invite him to join your team. Once he joins, you can issue commands via voice chat or the command wheel, and Barkle will carry it out.

● ● Barkle Skill Overview:

✧ Participate in Combat: Barkle helps advance and attack enemies when his recruiter engages in combat.

✧ Defend: Barkle returns to his recruiter's side and blocks shots with his body when their Health is low.

✧ Rescue: When his recruiter is knocked down, Barkle will carry them to a safe location and use up his own Health to rescue them.

✧ Carry: Barkle's recruiter can command him to carry them to a specified location.

✧ Heal: If Barkle is defeated and his recruiter is nearby, he will instantly restore their Health and Energy.

✧ Supply Search: Barkle's recruiter can ask him to help find supplies. Barkle can detect supplies within a certain range.


Themed Vehicle

Bramblewood Scorpion (Two-Seater Vehicle)

The Bramblewood Scorpion's stealth capabilities help bring more strategic depth to vehicles, helping players better seize opportunities, set ambushes, or escape in battle, by combining traversal and combat.

● How to Obtain: Find the Scorpion Horn item in-game to summon the Bramblewood Scorpion.

● Skills:

✧ Burrow: Stealthily burrow underground for rapid movement. The pilot and passengers cannot be attacked in this state. Burrowing consumes stealth energy, and the scorpion will be forced to resurface when energy runs out, or when its tail takes damages.

✧ Pincer Attack: Swing both pincers to strike enemies in front.

✧ Spike Bomb: Aim and fire at a target, dealing area damage and inflicting a slowing effect in the area.

✧ Launch Slide: Passengers can use this to eject from the scorpion and slide on the ground for a brief period. Freely jump while sliding or cancel the slide at any time.



Cherry Blossom Deer (Two-Seater Vehicle)

We've noticed that many players use themed modes as a social space, so we created the elegant Cherry Blossom Deer that leaves a trail of flowers when it runs. We hope players can share a moment of peace and beauty with their teammates amidst the intense battleground, to ease the pressure.

● Feature: Lush plants grow in the wake of its steps, leaving behind a temporary trail of flowers.


Themed Item

Targeting Vines

Centered on control and counterplay, it provides controllable vines that can form a shield at critical moments, restrict enemy movement, change the tide of battle, and create offensive and counter-attack windows for allies.

● How to Obtain: Targeting Vines becomes available in matches when Primewood purification progress reaches 100%.

● Skills: Rare Skill Item

✧ Once acquired, it can be instantly deployed from the themed item slot to summon controllable vines. Control the direction of the vines by swiping the screen, to block enemies off or provide protection.

✧ Shield: After casting the skill, a one-time shield is generated around the user for the duration of a single skill. The shield blocks damage, but will break after taking sufficient damage.

✧ Ensnare: Tap the ensnare button to generate a red circle at the crosshair. Enemies or vehicles within the red circle must get out in time, otherwise they will be ensnared. Ensnared players can mash the break free button to escape faster. Teammates of ensnared players can also attack the ensnaring vines to help teammates break free sooner.

✧ Skill Cooldown: When the skill's duration is up, or their Health has been depleted, the skill immediately ends and enters cooldown. You can also prematurely cancel the skill by tapping it from the item bar again.


Florawings

We wanted to redefine player movement and spatial agility, so we designed this tactical item centered around motion. Its basic function is to smoothy get around the map, while also offering advanced players the ability to quickly reposition for attacks and execute tactical dodges, providing a tangible combat edge with three-dimensional movement.

● Skills: Rare Skill Item

After equipping, you can view the equipment status in the backpack item tab, and your character will show wings on its back.

Movement: After equipping, a skill button will permanently appear on the right side of the screen, offering four forms: Boost / Low-Altitude Flight / High-Altitude Flight / Flash. Tap the button and use the joystick + swipe screen to control direction and orientation. Flight and Flash consume energy, and your character will land when its depleted. Strong impacts or environmental restrictions (such as interiors/low-ceiling areas) will forcibly interrupt flight.

Harass: Teleport to a location and trigger a pollen flash to interfere with enemies, briefly blinding those affected.


Themed Firearm

Overgrowth - Honey Badger

Following the Kar98K in the last version, this time we're introducing the new themed Honey Badger. This gun can switch between rifle and pod shells, and is also capable of health recovery, allowing players to freely switch between long-range and close-range offense, defense, and support, for a refreshing gameplay experience.

● How to Obtain: Only available in the themed mode, with a thematic appearance and loot special effects.

● Skills:

✧ Health & Energy Recovery: When knocking down or eliminating an enemy, recover a certain amount of Health and Energy within 5 seconds. Triggering this multiple times in a short period will refresh the recovery duration.

✧ Attribute Bonus: Gain a firearm spread and stability bonus by standing still for several seconds while holding the firearm. Moving loses the bonus.

✧ Switch Forms: The firearm can switch to firing pod explosives. Hitting enemies deals explosive damage and applies a slight slowing debuff for several seconds. This form consumes multiple rounds per shot.


Gameplay Mechanic

Prime Eye

The Sacred Tree is not just lore in the background, it's something to interact with. We made an interactive instance, closely linked with Erangel and matches. With the Prime Eye, you can survey the entire battleground situation. Become a commander, and use skills to deploy formations and achieve highlight-reel comebacks through team coordination.

● Gameplay: Head to the Ishtar Gate on the map to enter the Primewood Heart instance and compete for the Prime Eye artifact. After acquiring the Prime Eye, use it to activate a bird's-eye view of Erangel and unleash various Sacred Tree skills to control the battle: Barrier, Teleport, Heal, and Corrupting Flower.

● Skills:

✧ Barrier: Summons an opaque barrier that blocks shots, and can be used to advance, hold positions, or cover teammates when relocating.

✧ Teleport: Place two portals to quickly teleport between, enabling highly mobile aggression and retreat.

✧ Heal: Generates a healing zone in the designated area, continuously restoring Health. Downed teammates within the area can be rescued, enhancing the team's battle sustainability.

✧ Corrupting Flower: Spawn a Corrupting Flower at the target location, dealing continuous damage to enemies within range. Defeating it grants high-value supply rewards.


Cross-Match Planting

Previously, each match was a standalone experience, lacking a sense of persistence between matches. Thus, we've incorporated a cross-match planting and harvesting system based on the Sacred Tree theme. Fruits you plant in one match will mature in subsequent matches, bringing new objectives and routes, so collecting supplies is no longer just about searching.

● Sacred Bud/Sacred Fruit: Plant and harvest supplies across matches.

✧ Plant: Pick up a Sacred Bud in-match and choose a safe location to plant it. This will be the harvesting point later on.

✧ Harvest: After playing a certain number of matches on the map, the Sacred Bud will absorb enough energy and mature into a Sacred Fruit. Interact with it to claim supply rewards. Sacred Fruits come in three qualities, with Gold Fruits having a chance to summon the treant ally Barkle to fight alongside you.

✧ Contention: Ripe fruits are visible to all players in this match, and others can pick them first. If a player takes another's fruit, their location will be exposed to the fruit's owner for a period of time. Be wary of retaliation.


Additionally, the highly anticipated V3.1 Skyhigh Spectacle themed mode will make a surprise return in early February. Everyone is welcome to embark on a new adventure above the clouds!


Classic Mode Updates

Firearm Adjustments

We're continuing to make the unique strengths of different firearms more defined. This update focuses on expanding the use cases of 7.62mm rifles, enhancing their optimal combat range. At the same time, we will continue to fine-tune shotguns and observe their combat performance.

● Slightly increased the base damage of 7.62mm ammo rifles. Applicable firearms:

✧ AKM: 48→50

✧ ACE32: 45→47

✧ M762: 46→48

✧ Honey Badger: 43→45

✧ Mk47: 48→50

✧ Groza: 48→49

● Slightly reduced shotgun shell damage. Affected firearms:

✧ S686: 24→23

✧ S1897: 24→23

✧ S12K: 22→21

✧ M1014: 24 → 23

✧ DBS: 24→23

✧ NS2000: 26→25

✧ Slightly adjusted the shotgun's spread range, making pellet distribution more random.


Firearm Spawn Adjustments

●DBS Shotgun: Added to Livik as a ground supply.

●SCAR-L Assault Rifle: Added to Sanhok and Vikendi as a ground supply.

●DP-28 Light Machine Gun: Added to Sanhok, Miramar, Karakin, and Vikendi as a ground supply.


Cooperative Climbing

Introducing the first-ever two-player climbing mechanic, designed to expand vertical paths and tactical options. Boost and pull each other up to break through height and terrain limitations, create more ascent and movement routes, and enjoy a more layered three-dimensional exploration experience.

● Feature Overview: Work with teammates to reach high places inaccessible alone, for expanded attack routes and high-ground positions.

● Usage: Every player has a Co-op Wristband in their backpack. Equip it to actively trigger cooperative climbing. It is issued by default in Classic Mode and Payload.

● Boost Teammate: While crouching, assume a ready stance with hands clasped. A teammate can then boost off your hands to get higher.

● Pull Up teammate: Get into a ready stance at a high position to pull someone up. A teammate can then climb up by grabbing your hand.


Basic Combat Improvements

● Cut Away ParachuteIf you get stuck in the gap of a building or other irregular situation for more than 10 seconds while parachuting and landing, an option to cut away the parachute will appear. Tap it to immediately get rid of the parachute and avoid getting stuck for a prolonged period of time and disrupting your early-game looting..

● 4x Scope Changeable Crosshair: Changing crosshairs only applies to the current weapon.

● Throwable Improvements:

✧ After tossing a throwable, hold down the attack button to quickly follow up with the next one after a short charge, for a better rhythm when throwing consecutively, and improved efficiency when transitioning between offense and defense.

✧ During the throw preparation phase, tapping the weapon slot will immediately cancel the throw and switch to your weapon, allowing you to react to sudden changes in the situation or to quickly switch targets.

● Prone Improvements:

✧ When prone and aiming down sights, brief movements (approx. 0.5 seconds) will not exit you out of ADS, reducing unintended actions and improving the consistency between recoil control and observation.

✧ When prone against a wall and horizontally rotating the camera, your character will rotate normally without being blocked by the wall, improving gathering intel when hugging the wall or corners.

● Climbing Improvements:

✧ Improved the window edge detection so that climbing is triggered more consistently.

✧ Improved the animation transition between climbing and the climbing camera to be smoother.

● Enter Training Grounds as a Team:

✧ When teaming up in the Lobby, you can team up to enter the Training Grounds under Unranked.

✧ When in the Training Grounds, you can also invite friends to join your team and enter your Training Grounds.

● Reconnect During Loading: If a match fails to load due to a timeout, you can now reconnect to reduce losses outside of combat caused by disconnections.

● Highlights: Now supports selecting a starting playback segment. Jump to a specified segment during playback for quick review.

● Season Rewards Fully Upgraded:

✧ Platinum: Updated Season Set, Season Bonus Point Card ×2.

✧ Ace: Updated Season Backpack, MVP Badge, Ace Badge.

✧ Ace Master: Updated Season Helmet, Victory Pose, Ace Master Badge. Ace Dominator: Updated Badge Display Emote, MVP Emote, Ace Dominator Badge.

Ultimate Royale

Promotion Match

Recently, we've received feedback from some players that the current pace of climbing the ranks is too fast, leading to a lack of motivation and challenge in the long run, especially among high-tier players who generally report a lack of long-term goals and high-quality matches. To remedy this, we are introducing a highly challenging Promotion Match mechanic: Players must pass a Promotion Match to advance to Ace tier. We hope that this adjustment will allow players to more stably compete with players of similar strength, with more balanced matches and a greater sense of achievement.

● Season Duration: 2026/1/11 at 2:00–2026/3/14 at 23:59 (UTC+0)

● Core Mechanic Overview:

✧ New highly challenging Promotion Match mechanism for Ace tier and above. You must consecutively achieve the specified individual rank goal on Erangel or Livik to be promoted and unlock the corresponding tier and rewards.

✧ Server-Wide Ranking Qualification: You must first complete the Ace Promotion challenge and reach Ace tier before you can enter the Conqueror server-wide ranking.

✧ Promotion Matches are individual challenges. Other players in the same match (including teammates and opponents) will not receive any notifications, and the regular match experience will not be affected.

● Promotion Match Rewards

✧ Glory: Promoting unlocks higher-tier rank names (e.g., promoting from Crown I to Ace), which are displayed on your profile and in Lobby, showcasing your strength and achievements.

✧ Tier Reward: After completing the promotion challenge for the corresponding stage, you can claim season-exclusive rewards. Rewards will be issued upon successful promotion. Equip them from the season backpack in time.

➢ Ace: Season Backpack

➢ Ace Master: Season Helmet

➢ Ace Dominator: Glory Badge Display Emote (60d)

✧ Glory Mark: Each successful promotion grants 1 Promotion Point to upgrade and illuminate new Glory Badges, recording your high-tier achievements and milestone moments.

● Participation Rules:

✧ One-Time Verification: Within the same season, players only need to successfully complete the Promotion Match series challenge once across all servers and modes.

✧ Qualification Trigger: When your rating points in any mode (Solo/Duo/Squad, TPP/FPP) first reach the Promotion Match threshold (4,199/4,699/5,199), you will unlock the qualification for the same set of Promotion Match challenges.

✧ Mode Restriction: Promotion Matches are only available in TPP - Squad.

✧ Available Maps: Themed Erangel, Classic Erangel, Themed Livik, Classic Livik (Challenge objectives are proportional to map size to ensure fairness.)

✧ Optional Participation: Promotion Matches are completely optional and are manually selected from Start interface.

✧ Team Up Requirements: Promotion Matches aim to provide a more rigorous competitive environment, so there is a minimum tier requirement for teammates.

➢ Promoting to Ace: Teammates must be Crown V tier or higher.

➢ Promoting to Ace Master: Teammates must be Ace tier or higher.

➢ Promoting to Ace Dominator: Teammates must be Ace Master tier or higher.

✧ Promotion Requirements:

✧ Promoting to Ace: Unlocked after reaching 4,199 Rating Points and individually ranking in the top 15 (Erangel)/top 8 (Livik) in 3 consecutive matches.

✧ Promoting to Ace Master: Unlocked after reaching 4,699 Rating Points and individually ranking in the top 12 (Erangel)/top 6 (Livik) in 4 consecutive matches.

✧ Promoting to Ace Dominator: Unlocked after reaching 5,199 Rating Points and individually ranking in the top 10 (Erangel)/top 5 (Livik) in 5 consecutive matches.

✧ Settlement Rules:

✧ Rank Determination: Your rank is determined based on the number of remaining enemy players on the battleground excluding teammates when you are completely eliminated.

✧ Scoring Rules: Promotion Matches will calculate Rating Points, Challenge Points, and Combat Power normally. However, Rating Point bonuses (tier protection, returner bonuses, event bonuses, etc.) will not take effect during settlement.

✧ Progress Protection: You automatically gain 1 Progress Protection for each new Promotion Match. It automatically gets used up if you fail the match, and keeps your current challenge progress.

✧ Promotion Match Settlement: Same-Mode Real-Time Calculation: If you are up for promotion in TPP Squad, then the Promotion Match score will be calculated in real time. Cross-Mode Delayed Calculation: If you are up for promotion in a mode other than TPP Squad, the Promotion Match score will be stored and calculated together the next time you play a regular match in the mode in which you were up for promotion.

✧ Unlock Record: Promotion Match qualification is linked to the server and mode where the player first reached the unlock score.

✧ Privacy Settings: Promotion status is visible to friends by default and can be hidden in the privacy settings.

✧ Individual Challenge: Other players in the same match (including teammates and opponents) will not receive any notification.


Season Series

Beyond seasonal pursuits, active veteran players lack a unified, way of showing off the honor of their "perseverance." Therefore, we are introducing the Season Series System: a prestigious top honor system established on a semi-annual basis, designed with honors that take multiple aspects into account, to ensure that players excelling in "Perseverance," "Strength," and "Technique" all receive the recognition they deserve.

● Overview: This system uses Season Series as the settlement period. 1 Season Series = Half Year Period = 3 Seasons. The progress of Season Series Medals, Continuous Challenges, Trial Challenges, and the Season Series Treasury lasts for a whole Season Series, and only resets when a new Season Series begins. (Note: Everything is based on the Season Series, and not individual seasons.)

● Season Series Medal: A testament to a player's strength throughout the Season Series.

✧ Medal Structure: The medal is made up of four parts: the core gem, central chassis, light effect, and surrounding star halo. Each corresponds to different progress of the Season Series. They upgrade instantly once conditions are met.

✧ Core Gem (Perseverance): Based on the number of seasons that Crown tier has been reached in the current Season Series. The more seasons that Crown tier has been reached, the more lustrous its form.

✧ Central Chassis (Activity): Based on how many seasons you have logged in on over 40 days in the current Season Series. The more seasons this has been achieved in, the more exquisite its appearance.

✧ Border Light Effect (Outstanding Skill): Based on the highest Classic tier (Ace/Ace Master/Ace Dominator) achieved in the current Season Series. The higher the tier, the more radiant the light effect.

✧ Star Halo (Technique): During this Season Series, complete any 10 missions from the Trial Challenge mission pool to light up all the stars on the star halo one by one.

● Continuous Challenge: A symbol of continued tier excellence.

✧ Objective: You must achieve the specified tier in all three seasons of the same Season Series to earn the corresponding rewards.

✧ Catch-Up Mechanic: There are no catch-up missions for this challenge. However, you can use a Season Series Catch-Up Core to instantly complete an unfinished challenge that is one season away (e.g. progress is at 2/3) before the Season Series settlement period.

✧ Note: The Season Series Catch-Up Core is only valid for the current Season Series and if unused, will automatically expire after settlement.

✧ Obtain 1 Season Series Catch-Up Core when reaching a total of 3,000 Season Series Points from Trial Challenges.

● Trial Challenge

✧ Purpose: Complete them to earn Season Series Tokens and Season Series Medal upgrades.

✧ Point Rules: Complete high-difficulty trial missions within a match to earn Trial Points.

✧ Dynamic Limit: The Trial Points limit increases as the seasons progress, allowing for players to catch up:

➢ Season 1: 1,000 points limit

➢ Season 2: 2,000 points limit

➢ Season 3: 3,000 points limit

✧ Rewards:

➢ Season Series Token: Reach specific progress milestones to claim Season Series Tokens.

➢ Medal Growth: Complete trials marked with the Season Series Medal to light up the medal's Star Halo.

✧ Mission Pool Update: The version will continuously update the Trial Challenge mission pool. Newly added missions will also count towards and light up the medal's Star Halo.

● Season Series Treasury

✧ Purpose: Use Season Series Tokens to redeem exclusive top rewards in the shop.

✧ Update Period: Content is updated on a Season Series basis.

✧ Token Rules: Cycle-exclusive tokens obtained from Trial Challenges and Continuous Challenges do not expire and can be accumulated across Cycles.

✧ Return Mechanic: Previous Season Series rewards and Continuous Challenge exclusive rewards will return here at a higher price, allowing you to acquire desired cosmetic items and honors.


World of Wonder Updates

We have supercharged the editor with AI technology, lowering the barrier to creation and helping everyone realize their ideas more easily. This update also brings major upgrades to the editor, adding features such as automatically generating grouped objects from text descriptions and generating animations from uploaded reference videos through the AI assistant. Additionally, a new trending Special Collection category has been added, allowing Creators to submit their creations for extra exposure from players.

In-Match Features

● AI Smart Assistant Update:

✧ New Animation Generation Feature: Upload a video to generate a corresponding skeletal animation that can be used by armed AI in visual programming and Virtual Projection Devices. (This feature will initially only be available to Creators at WOW Creation Level ≥ 18, with wider availability at a later date.)

✧ New Grouped Object Generation Feature: Generate grouped objects through text descriptions to be used in the scenery. (This feature will initially only be available to Creators at WOW Creation Level ≥ 18, with wider availability at a later date.)

✧ Supports floating windows and UI scaling. Each map will have its own edit history for the last 7 days.

● PvE Enemy Skill Casting: PvE enemies and armed AI can cast throwing or building skills via command blocks.

● Universal Feature Unlock Control: A universal content unlock control has been added to the UI editor, allowing you to set unlock conditions and activation rewards to implement features such as talent trees.

● Expanded Custom Resources:

✧ Added a Private Library tab to My Resources for managing private custom resources. The resource limit has been increased to 100.

✧ The prefab backpack has been merged into the Private Library, allowing for more prefab resources to be saved. Trigger groups can also be saved as templates and reused in the visual programming editor.

✧ Trigger groups can be saved as templates in the visual programming editor and stored in the Private Library, to be used as custom templates within the editor.

✧ AI-generated character animations can be saved to the Private Library and used for armed AI in visual programming and the Virtual Projection Device.

✧ Character animations and visual code template resources have been added to the Resource Center. All resource types in the Private Library can now be published to the Resource Center.

✧ Added the Used Resource Management page, where you can manage character animations already used in creations, and locate, delete, and unlink them.

✧ Added the Loaded Resource Management page, where you can manage and unload character animations already loaded in the map.

● Firearm Editor: Added a new firearm editor, allowing you to modify data such as the damage and firing speed of specified firearms, and adjust item quality for a richer shooting experience.

✧ When entering text, the character limit is displayed, and turns red when over the limit.

✧ Improved the custom process name interface.

✧ Improved the parameter editing page for widescreen.

✧ Added quick switching for mission parameters and phase parameters.

✧ If multiple selected objects all have a certain attribute and the options are consistent, the attribute can be edited, and the changes will apply to all the selected objects.

✧ If multiple selected devices are of the same type, an attribute can be edited, and the changes will apply to all the selected devices.


Out-of-Match Features Update

● Resource Center Location Addition: Added an access point for the Resource Center outside of matches, for you to browse and favorite resources, and manage My Resources.

● Updated Template Creation:

✧ Categorized template information more clearly by gameplay type.

✧ Updated the design and description of some templates.

✧ Added new tags: Trending, For Experts, Used By Friends.

✧ Some templates now feature outstanding creation recommendations to act as a reference and learn from.

✧ Improved the template download process, classification, and display order.

Vehicles: Vehicle Combat, Vehicle Training

PvE: Monster Slaying Tower Ascension

● Updated Category Tags:

✧ "Racing" has been changed to "Vehicles." The default main tag order has been adjusted to: Arena - Free-For-All - Parkour - Casual - PvE - Puzzle - Vehicles. Select a main category tag to see its description.

✧ Added feature tag categories. The default order is: Competitive PvP - Parkour - Casual - PvPvE - Puzzle - Vehicles - Visual Style - Content Theme, and new feature tag names have been added.

Selecting a main tag will pin the corresponding feature tag category to the top.

Removed completion time and difficulty tags, and disabled the player voting tag feature.

● Auto Translate Improvements:

✧ Improved the auto translate feature for creations.

✧ Merged in-match and global translation settings. The same setting now applies to all scenarios.

✧ The setting is automatically saved, and does not need to be reset when switching creations.

● "My" Page Performance Improvements:

✧ Added a new homepage displaying information such as Recently Played, Social Discovery, and Feature Access.

✧ Optimized the layout and interaction of secondary pages such as Favorites, History, Following, and Friends.

✧ Added a search function to the Favorite Creations and History pages, supporting fuzzy search by creation name.

● Creation Sharing Challenge:

✧ When you achieve a rank, score, or complete a creation, you can invite friends to challenge it via the Share feature.

✧ The initiator will be notified of the invitee's challenge results, and challenges can be repeated.

● Trending Special Collections:

✧ Special Collections have been added to the daily trending page.

✧ Special Collections are driven by trending features, versions, interest profiles, etc. Outstanding creations will periodically be selected for display and exposure.

✧ Creators can opt to participate in designated Special Collections when publishing creations. Well-crafted creations have a higher chance of being selected for increased exposure. They can also preview current and upcoming Special Collections, and some Special Collections support redirecting to templates.

✧ Play Special Collection creations to get WOW Pass Points up to 3 times per week.

● Creation Lobby:

✧ Tap Play Together to see the new Creation Lobby list.

✧ The Creation Lobby displays a list of creations in matchmaking that are closest to starting.

✧ You can quickly add creations, select specific creations to add, or refresh the list.


Resource Integration

● Themed Mode Monsters: Corrupting Mega Flower, Corrupting Flower

● Themed Mode Item: Florawings. Equip it to fly, boost, dash, and trigger pollen flashes to disrupt enemies.

● Theme Mode Item: Targeting Vines. Cast constricting vines at the target location and form a vine shield around the user.

● Sticky Bomb: Deals damage in a wide range and can stick to any wall or vehicle surface and explodes after a short countdown.

● Full-Auto Mod: Usable with semi-automatic rifles such as the M16A4 and Mk47. Equipping it grants a full-auto firing mode.


Win-Win Earnings Model

● WOW Pass Update

Metro Royale Updates

Six months after V3.9, we're introducing the new inheritable weapon, Glacix Arbiter. Inspired by the butterfly knife and infused with the imagery of ice, it further enhances the blade's sharpness and texture, aiming to bring players a unique and exhilarating combat experience.

Season Updates

● ● Season Duration: 2026/1/8 at 2:00 — 2026/3/10 at 20:59 (UTC+0). Chapter 30 is now available, with new season collectibles and new content to experience.

● New Fabled Melee Weapon: Glacix Arbiter

✧ Only available in Chapter 30. Has a chance to drop when eliminating zombie-type monsters, mutant flowers, mutant vines, or bosses in the map.

✧ Katia's Reciprocal Reward: A Glacix Arbiter obtained via the above methods will come with the limited perk to gift an additional identical weapon to a connected friend.

● Rendering: Optimized the vegetation culling distance strategy.

content_html:
Dear Players,

To give everyone a better gaming experience, Version 4.2's third beta test is scheduled for December 18. A new season of Metro Royale has arrived, bringing with it the new Fabled melee weapon, Glacix Arbiter. It is retained between seasons, and you won't drop it when you get eliminated. Every strike has a possibility to one-shot enemies. High-value sellable items can also be found in Vine Crates that randomly spawn throughout the map. Major WOW Smart Assistant update with expanded AI implementation to assist your creations. Unleash your infinite creativity with the new version.

The beta server's exclusive Discord community (https://discord.gg/BDuH8utDBg) is now available. Head over to get official download links for the beta server and exchange tips with other players! The official team will also be hosting events from time to time, so stay tuned!


Metro Royale Updates

Gameplay Update

● Vine CrateVines Crates are distributed randomly throughout the map. Open them for a chance to obtain valuable sellable items.

● New Fabled Melee Weapon - Glacix Arbiter:

✧ Exclusive Special Trait: Has a chance to one-shot PvE enemies and bandits.

✧ Only available in Chapter 30. Has a chance to drop when eliminating zombie-type monsters or bosses in the map.

✧ Retained between seasons, and does not drop upon elimination when equipped.

● New Fabled Sellable Item: Military Drone. Has a chance to appear in all types of crates on the map.

● Updated with new collectibles.

To give everyone a better gaming experience, Version 4.2's second beta test is scheduled for December 11. Traverse the Primewood Heart to obtain the Prime Eye. This artifact contains a mysterious and powerful force—it not only grants a bird's-eye view of the battleground, but also allows multiple skills to be unleashed at will, and can even summon corrupting flowers that disrupts enemies. The new themed firearm, Overgrowth - Honey Badger can also switch between combat modes for enhanced firepower, making it an excellent partner in battle.

The beta server's exclusive Discord community (https://discord.gg/BDuH8utDBg) is now available. Head over to get official download links for the beta version and exchange tips with other players! The official team will also be hosting events from time to time, so stay tuned!


New Themed Mode: Primewood Genesis

Map Areas

● Primewood Heart:

✧ Enter the Primewood Heart through the Ishtar Gate.

✧ In the Primewood Heart, you can obtain the rare Prime Eye item. With the Prime Eye, you can activate a bird's-eye view of Erangel and unleash various skills (Barrier, Teleport, Heal, Corrupting Flower, etc.) to control the entire battleground.


Themed Gameplay

● Prime Eye:

✧ Barrier: Summons a huge, opaque shield that blocks shots and cuts off lines of fire.

✧ Teleport: Place two portals that allow one-way teleportation from the first to the second portal.

✧ Heal: Summon a healing zone that continually restores players' Health and rescues downed players.

✧ Corrupting Flowers: Deploys a cluster of plants that can deal damage to players within range. Destroying the plants grants high quality supplies.


Themed Firearm

● Overgrowth - Honey Badger:

✧ Recover some Health and Energy when eliminating or knocking down enemies.

✧ Firing stability increases after standing still for a few seconds.

✧ Switch forms to change the firing mode and consume more ammo to fire explosive shots.


Classic Mode Updates

● Cooperative Climbing:

✧ Reach higher places that you can't get to by yourself where the Sacred Deer passes through with the help of a teammate.

✧ Every player has the Co-op Wristband item in their backpack by default. When equipped, it can be used to trigger cooperative climbing by entering a preparatory state to help a teammate climb.

✧ Lifting Teammate: While crouching, you can assume a preparatory pose and clasp your hands together to lift a teammate. Other players can boost off your hands to reach higher places.

✧ Pulling Teammate: You can assume a preparatory pose from up above to grab and pull teammates upwards.

● Climbing Improvements:

✧ Climbing is smoother now, and the camera movement during climbing has been improved.

✧ Updated some template designs, adding more information including map size, play time, multi-map previews, etc.

Dear Players:

To give everyone a better gaming experience, Version 4.2's first beta test is scheduled for December 4. The power of the Sacred Tree awakens, and the world is turned upside down! Cities are reshaped by the life energy, while mutated plants spread wildly, with contaminated areas full of danger. Step into the unknown, eliminate the ferocious contamination source, and purify the eroded land! Banish the darkness and win the rewards of the Sacred Tree! Confront the twisted will of nature, protect the power of the Sacred Tree, and join the new battleground now!

The beta server's exclusive Discord community (https://discord.gg/BDuH8utDBg) is now available. Head over to get official download links for the beta version and exchange tips with other players! The official team will also be hosting events from time to time, so stay tuned!


New Themed Mode: Primewood Genesis

Map Areas

● Corrupted City:

✧ Several major urban areas on the map have new buildings, and their appearance and environment have changed due to the influence of the Sacred Tree.

✧ The cities are also filled with various corrupted plants, surrounded by vision-impairing corrupting fog and twisting corruption vines.

✧ Some areas are inaccessible due to being blocked by tree roots. Purifying the corresponding areas will cause the tree roots to wither, at which point you can enter and explore normally.

● Corruption Plant Zone:

✧ Corruption areas with high concentrations of ominous energy will be marked on the map. This energy has condensed into sinister flowers that seek to corrupt and destroy the land.

✧ Destroy the corrupting plants in the Corruption Plant Zone to help the Sacred Tree purify the land. After destroying all the corrupting plants, the Sacred Tree will grant supplies.


Themed Vehicle

● Sacred Deer:

✧ A sacred deer with plant features that can be ridden by two players.

✧ Flowers and foliage bloom beneath the deer’s hooves, leaving a trail of green in its wake.

● Bramblewood Scorpion:

✧ A giant scorpion with plant features that can be summoned with the Bramble Horn.

✧ The Bramblewood Scorpion is a two-seater vehicle with the following skills:

➢ Burrow - The scorpion burrows underground for rapid movement. In this state, the rider cannot be attacked. Burrowing has its own energy bar, and the scorpion will resurface when it runs out of energy or its tail is damaged by enemies.

➢ Spike Bomb - The scorpion fires spike bombs at a target, dealing AoE damage and slowing enemies in the area.

➢ Pincer Strike - The scorpion swings its pincers, dealing melee damage to enemies in front of it.

➢ Launch Slide - A passenger skill that can be triggered when riding the scorpion. Once triggered, the player will be ejected from the scorpion and briefly slide on the ground for quick movement. During the slide, you can jump at any time to interrupt the slide.


Themed Items

● Florawings:

✧ When equipping the Florawings, the backpack item slot will show its equipped status, and your character's back will gain floral wings.

✧ When equipped, skill buttons will appear on the right side of the screen (including Dash/Low-Altitude Flight/High-Altitude Flight/Flash): After tapping them, use the joystick and swipe the screen to control your direction and orientation. Flash triggers a pollen flash at your landing spot that disrupts all players. Enemies are briefly blinded, and the effect is halved on allies.

✧ While the wings are in use, an energy/duration bar will be displayed at the top of the screen showing real-time consumption during flight and flashes. You will automatically land when the energy runs out or after some time.

✧ Flight can be interrupted by strong attacks or environmental restrictions (e.g., indoors or low ceilings).

● Vine Manipulation:

✧ Equip to gain the constrict skill.

✧ Launch vines that constrict at a target location while forming a shield around you. While the skill is active, use the wheel on the left of the screen to control the vines and find enemies. If they make contact with an enemy, they will be wrapped up by the vines. Restricted enemies can mash a button to break free.

✧ Vines being controlled by the player have a health bar, and when depleted, will end the skill.

✧ Vines that have wrapped up an enemy also have a health bar, and on taking damage, will release the enemy quicker.


Themed Gameplay Mechanics

● Lumina Fruit Planting:

✧ You can cultivate magical plants to harvest supplies across matches.

✧ Planting - Pick up Lumina Fruit buds containing a portion of the Sacred Tree's power from the themed mode. Choose a place to plant the bud, and the Lumina Fruit will start accumulating energy underground.

✧ Harvest - After playing a couple matches on the same map, the Lumina Fruit will be ready to harvest. Interact with it to obtain supply rewards.

✧ Contest: Mature Lumina Fruit trees will be visible to all players in the match, so other players may steal the fruits of your labor before you can get to it. However, if they steal your fruit, their location will be visible to you for a period of time.


Classic Mode Updates

● Pull Doors Open: You can now pull doors open towards you.

● Cut Away Parachute: Added an option to cut away the parachute when nearing landing.

● 4x Scope Crosshair Switching: The 4x scope crosshair switch feature now only applies to the current weapon.

● Prone Improvements: You now remain in ADS mode when moving slowly while prone. Improved turning while prone to prevent getting blocked by walls.

● Gyroscope: Added a dedicated throwables toggle for the gyroscope.
